messages.content: Return only a JavaScript function topoSort(nodes, edges). nodes is an array of unique string IDs. edges is an array of [from,to] pairs, meaning from must precede to. Endpoints are guaranteed in nodes. Return a topological order containing every node exactly once; among currently ready nodes, always choose the lexicographically smallest. Duplicate edges must not cause false cycles. Return null on any cycle including a self-loop. Do not mutate nodes or edges. Empty graph returns []. No external packages.
